card.name: Words before cracking or hacking a password
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, how, be, also, if) in passages on password or encryption strength, just before a verb like decrypt, crack, guess or hack is expected.

modes.label: Time to break encryption
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'how' before decrypt or solve, when judging how strong a cipher is.

modes.label: Passwords can be hacked
modes.description: Auxiliary words such as be or also before hacked or deciphered, in talk of weak passwords or codes.
modes.example: that option is not strong enough, as passwords can also<< be>> hacked.
